Willingdon Wealth Management Has Cut Its Holding in Intel (INTC) as Valuation Rose; Teacher Retirement System Of Texas Has Raised Essex Ppty Tr (ESS) Stake
May 21, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Teacher Retirement System Of Texas increased its stake in Essex Ppty Tr Inc (ESS) by 37.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Teacher Retirement System Of Texas bought 10,791 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 39,821 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.61 million, up from 29,030 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Teacher Retirement System Of Texas who had been investing in Essex Ppty Tr Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.91 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.73% or $3.97 during the last trading session, reaching $232.84. About 295,772 shares traded. Essex Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE:ESS) has risen 0.21% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.34% the S&P500.
Willingdon Wealth Management decreased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 9.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Willingdon Wealth Management sold 9,662 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 89,100 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.11 million, down from 98,762 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Willingdon Wealth Management who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $253.13 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.53% or $0.82 during the last trading session, reaching $54.32. About 21.64M shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
